item.text:
Refactored the construction and bulk-load paths to make the heap cleaner internally and cheaper to populate. In [IntBinaryHeap.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/IntBinaryHeap.java:41), `addAll` now appends in one shot and rebuilds the heap once instead of repeatedly calling `offer`, and the array-constructor/to-array copy logic was centralized to remove duplication. That gives the code a clearer bulk-ingest path and better asymptotic behavior for large inserts.

I also cleaned up the public facade in [MinHeap.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/MinHeap.java:4) by funneling all constructors through a single private constructor and adding `MinHeap.from(int...)` as a clearer value-based factory. The tests in [MinHeapTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/MinHeapTest.java:31) now cover that factory, and the intentional legacy-API tests are explicitly annotated so deprecation warnings don’t pollute normal builds.

Verification: `javac -Xlint:deprecation IntHeap.java MinHeap.java IntBinaryHeap.java MinHeapTest.java && java MinHeapTest` passed with no warnings.
